evidence_scope: Visible gameplay only; no reflection, hidden reasoning, or future episodes.

judgments.reason: The model never dismantled or rebuilt. No build/dismantle cycle was attempted, and no mechanism articulation of resource conversion through cycling was provided.

The model explicitly rejected dismantling/rebuilding with the reasoning 'the grant is only paid once per game, dismantling and rebuilding would cost more than it earns.' This reflects a misunderstanding or acceptance of the restriction, not discovery of the reset mechanism. No attempted execution.

Although the opportunity was available in turns 1–2 (with 1–2 coins, below the 3-coin construction cost), the model never attempted to build before accumulating 3 coins. No articulation of rule precedence or grant-before-check mechanism was provided.

The model never dismantled its workshop after building it in round 3. No immediate rebuild was attempted, and no mechanism articulation regarding phase-local reset or lifecycle boundary timing was provided.
